verdict.rationale: Honeycomb publishes a pricing page that shows a free-forever plan with per-signal volume limits (event volume up to 20M/month, metrics data points up to 100M/month). That is self-serve and signal-specific, but the evidence shows no paid per-unit rates, so costs beyond the free tier cannot be predicted from it. Missing for 10: published paid-tier per-event and per-metric prices, a cost calculator or estimation guidance, evidence that larger plans need no sales contact, and independent corroboration of pricing transparency.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can predict costs from transparent published per-signal pricing without talking to sales

citations.quote: Event Volume: Up to 20M per month Metrics Data Points: Up to 100M per month
